The '''mother''' of [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She held the opinion that her son's taking of a [[Driver Education course]] would one day be useful,<ref name="Regina" /> but later disowned Garnet when he turned to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
